description: This file defines the PdfDatatableReportExportService class, which implements report export functionality specifically for PDF formats within the data querying infrastructure of the application. It utilizes a reporting service to retrieve report PDFs and prepares HTTP responses for download.

classes.name: PdfDatatableReportExportService
classes.description: A Spring service class implementing report export functionality for PDF files, leveraging a reporting service to generate PDFs and prepare HTTP responses for clients.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Generates a PDF report based on provided parameters, retrieves the PDF file path from the reporting service, and constructs an HTTP response with the PDF file as the entity for download.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks if the given export target parameter indicates PDF export support.
